Ground & Gather Landing Page - Build Log
Date: 2026-02-22
Project type: Static HTML + CSS only (no JavaScript, no frameworks)

Overview
- Built a single-page landing page for the fictional neighborhood coffee shop "Ground & Gather."
- Audience target: mixed technical comfort (students and adults).
- Design goals: clear, simple, trustworthy.

Core structure implemented (in this exact order)
1) Hero
2) Problem
3) Solution
4) Features
5) Testimonials
6) Pricing
7) CTA
8) Footer

Files created
- index.html
- styles.css

First draft content delivered
- Semantic HTML structure with accessible section labels.
- Brand-focused hero with primary CTA.
- Problem/Solution framing.
- Features section (rewritten for clearer value communication):
  - Built for fast, reliable coffee runs without extra friction.
  - Order in Minutes:
    - Place your order in a few taps and skip the line.
    - Outcome: less waiting, faster pickup.
    - Proof: most orders are ready in 10-15 minutes.
  - Transparent Pricing:
    - See clear prices up front with no confusing surprises.
    - Outcome: easy decisions and better budget control.
    - Proof: straightforward menu pricing and plan options.
  - Quality Guarantee:
    - If something is not right, we make it right quickly.
    - Outcome: confidence every time you order.
    - Proof: backed by our remake promise.
  - Low-Friction Experience:
    - Get started without complicated setup or commitments.
    - Outcome: easy for first-time and repeat customers.
    - Proof: no app required, no contract, cancel anytime.
- Testimonials.
- Three-tier pricing cards.
- Final CTA and contact footer details.

Five small iteration improvements (applied sequentially)
1) Added in-page top navigation links for section scanning.
2) Added trust signals under Solution:
   - locally owned messaging
   - transparent pricing
   - remake promise
3) Added accessibility enhancements:
   - "Skip to main content" link
   - visible keyboard focus styles
4) Highlighted a "Most Popular" pricing plan.
5) Reduced signup friction:
   - reassurance copy ("No app required. No contract. Cancel anytime.")
   - added secondary CTA button.

Image strategy and implementation
- Curated stock image options for all key sections.
- Implemented section images directly in the page:
  - Hero
  - Problem
  - Solution
  - Features (4 value cards with one image per card)
  - Testimonials
  - Pricing (one image per product card)
  - CTA
- Added responsive image treatment and consistent visual styling.
- Added descriptive alt text and lazy loading on non-hero images.

Pricing alignment bug fix
- Issue: "Most Popular" badge pushed that card image down, causing misalignment.
- Fix: moved badge to absolute positioning and adjusted popular card top padding.
- Result: pricing card images aligned consistently.

Online ordering information added
- Added "How to Order Online" block inside Solution section.
- Included:
  - short explanatory intro
  - 3-step ordered process
  - readiness time trust note (10-15 minutes)
  - online order CTA link
  - supporting image

CSS/layout enhancements across work
- Reusable split layout for text + image sections.
- Reusable section image styling.
- Feature card grid and feature card image styling, plus pricing image styling.
- Popular plan badge styling and corrected positioning.
- Mobile behavior: stack split layouts at narrow widths.

Quality checks performed
- Lint checks run after substantive edits.
- No linter errors reported in edited files.

Current status
- Landing page is fully static and functional with content, visuals, and ordering guidance.
- Next optional step: replace placeholder order URL with production ordering endpoint.
